name: Hill climbing: five blocks, h1 stuck after 4 moves, h2 solves in 7
note: E is on B, D is on E, A is on C. Goal: the tower A, B, C, D, E. h1 climbs for 4 moves (-5 to 3) and stops at a local maximum with D and E stacked on C. h2 dismantles the wrong structures first and reaches the goal in 7 moves.
